title: This Tree Explodes and Fires Its Seeds at 160 Miles an Hour

scenes.text: There's a tree that explodes like a bomb.
It's called the dynamite tree, and it grows in the rainforests of the Americas.
When its pumpkin-shaped fruit dries out, it bursts with a loud bang.
The seeds fly out at about 160 miles an hour, and can land over 100 feet away.
The sap and seeds are toxic, and the trunk is covered in thorns.
A tree that explodes. Yes, really.

description:
There's a tree that explodes like a bomb.

Would you walk under it?
first_comment: A plant that fires seeds at 160 mph: would you stand under it or run?
